faqs.question: Are SmoothSelf products suitable for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Yes! All our formulations are dermatologically tested, pH-balanced (5.5), and free from parabens, mineral oils, phthalates, and harsh synthetic sulfates. If you have extreme sensitivities, we always recommend patch-testing on your inner wrist.

faqs.question: Does the body lotion leave a greasy or sticky residue?
faqs.answer: Not at all. Our signature emulsions are engineered to absorb in under 30 seconds into cellular layers, leaving behind a smooth, silky touch so you can dress immediately without stains.

faqs.question: What are your delivery timelines and shipping charges?
faqs.answer: We provide Free Standard Shipping on all orders over ₹450 across India. For orders below ₹450, standard shipping is ₹50. Orders are dispatched within 24–48 business hours and delivered within 2–5 business days.

faqs.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery (COD)?
faqs.answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available across all serviceable pin codes in India, alongside secure online payments through UPI, Cards, NetBanking, and Wallets.
